security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, official Firebase documentation links, and language examples. The actionable risks are npm and npx Firebase CLI commands that install tooling, enumerate Firebase metadata, or provision AI Logic. I found no prompt injection or malicious exfiltration intent in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Unpinned Firebase CLI installation and execution
remediation.suggestion: Pin firebase and firebase-tools to reviewed versions, and ask for user approval before running npm or npx commands.

remediation.issue: Firebase project enumeration and provisioning commands
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the active Firebase project and app before projects:list, apps:list, or init ailogic. Explain expected cloud changes first.

content.value_statement: Adding Gemini features to client apps requires correct Firebase setup, model selection, and production safeguards. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused Firebase AI Logic guidance.
actual_capabilities: Guides Firebase AI Logic setup for web, Android, iOS, and Flutter apps.
Explains Firebase CLI provisioning and client initialization requirements.
Shows patterns for text generation, chat, streaming, and multimodal input.
Covers structured output and image generation model configuration.
Highlights App Check and Remote Config practices for production apps.
limitations: Does not replace official Firebase documentation or current SDK release notes.
Requires an existing Firebase project and platform-specific app configuration.
CLI steps can change cloud project settings and should be confirmed first.
Does not design a full backend proxy, quota strategy, or authentication system.

use_cases.title: Prototype Gemini features
use_cases.description: Add text generation, chat, or multimodal prompts to an existing Firebase app with platform-specific setup guidance.

use_cases.title: Prepare mobile integration
use_cases.description: Map the required Android, iOS, or Flutter SDK steps before adding Firebase AI Logic to a mobile release.

use_cases.title: Review production readiness
use_cases.description: Check whether App Check, model configuration, and Firebase project provisioning are addressed before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Start a web setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a JavaScript Firebase app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use firebase-ai-logic-basics to guide me through adding Firebase AI Logic to a web app. Ask which Firebase project and app I want to use before running commands.

prompt_templates.title: Add multimodal input
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate feature work for images or files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use firebase-ai-logic-basics to plan multimodal Gemini input for my Firebase app. Include file size limits, SDK setup, and user consent considerations.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare production security
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced launch review for a Firebase AI feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use firebase-ai-logic-basics to review my Firebase AI Logic production plan. Focus on App Check, Remote Config, project provisioning, and command approval.

prompt_templates.title: Design a cross-platform rollout
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning across web and mobile clients.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use firebase-ai-logic-basics to design a cross-platform Firebase AI Logic rollout for web, Android, iOS, and Flutter. Separate shared decisions from platform-specific steps.

output_examples.input: Add streaming Gemini responses to a Firebase web chat feature.
output: A Firebase AI Logic setup checklist for the web app.
A streaming response flow for the chat interface.
A note to confirm Firebase CLI commands before execution.

output_examples.input: Review whether my Flutter app is ready for Firebase AI Logic.
output: A reminder to provision AI Logic with Firebase CLI.
Security notes covering App Check and authenticated access.

output_examples.input: Plan structured Gemini output for a mobile app feature.
output: A model configuration plan for structured responses.
Validation steps for parsing model output safely.
Release notes to verify current Firebase SDK versions.

best_practices: Confirm the target Firebase project before running Firebase CLI commands.
Enable App Check before exposing AI Logic features in production clients.
Use Remote Config for model names when production updates need flexibility.
anti_patterns: Do not run npx Firebase commands without user approval and project confirmation.
Do not hardcode outdated Gemini model names in production client code.
Do not ship client AI features without quota and abuse protections.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers web, Android, iOS, and Flutter Firebase AI Logic setup and usage patterns.

faq.question: Does it write application code automatically?
faq.answer: It provides guided implementation patterns. Generated code still needs project-specific review and testing.

faq.question: Can it run Firebase CLI commands?
faq.answer: It may suggest Firebase CLI commands. Users should approve commands and confirm the active project first.

faq.question: Does it support multimodal Gemini prompts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for images, files, streaming responses, chat, and structured output.

faq.question: Is App Check required?
faq.answer: The skill treats App Check as a production safeguard for protecting API quota and Firebase resources.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill workflows.
